content.title: 2026 RBC Heritage Sunday TV coverage: How to watch Round 4
content.text: Matt Fitzpatrick is seeking his second RBC Heritage title on Sunday — and so is his closest competitor, Scottie Scheffler. Getty Images The final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage begins Sunday morning at Harbour Town Golf Links. Here’s everything you need to know to watch the tournament on Sunday, including full RBC Heritage TV coverage, streaming details and Round 4 tee times.How to watch RBC Heritage on SundayAt the tournament’s halfway point on Friday evening, Scottie Scheffler trailed leader Matt Fitzpatrick by seven shots. But the World No. 1 posted one of the day’s best rounds on Saturday, a sizzling seven-under 64, to climb within three shots of Fitzpatrick’s lead.Now Fitzpatrick (-17) and Scheffler (-14) will play in Sunday afternoon’s final pairing in what is sure to be an entertaining final round. Fitzpatrick won this tournament once before, in 2023, prevailing in a playoff against Jordan Spieth, while Scheffler won the following year, in 2024.You can watch the final round of the RBC Heritage on TV via Golf Channel beginning at 1 p.m. ET on Sunday, followed by the CBS broadcast at 3 p.m. ET. PGA Tour Live on ESPN+ will provide exclusive streaming coverage starting Sunday at 7 a.m. ET, as well as featured group and featured hole coverage all day long.Below you will find everything you need to know to watch the final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage. Get ESPN+ With an ESPN+ subscription, you gain access to PGA Tour Live, where you can stream the best PGA Tour events live from wherever you want. How to watch on TV SundayGolf Channel will air early final-round TV coverage of the 2026 RBC Heritage from 1-3 p.m. ET on Sunday, followed by the CBS broadcast from 3-6 p.m. ET.How to stream online SundayYou can stream the final round of the 2026 RBC Heritage via PGA Tour Live on ESPN+, which will offer streaming coverage starting at 7 a.m. ET on Sunday in addition to featured group and hole coverage.
